AWS separately confirmed an operational issue with the Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud service in the US-EAST-1 Region, according to its status page. "We initiated a rollback of the problematic deployment and began observing initial signs of recovery at 4:44 PM."
According to AWS' latest update, "existing instances remain unaffected. The issue has been resolved and the service is operating normally."

title: Robinhood reports service recovery after AWS EC2 disruption
